plan: Drive: from District of Tumbler Ridge, about 82 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 52, Redwillow Branch 1 FSR, Redwillow Branch 2 FSR.
Park: 54.7073, -120.16188, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 2.2 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 138 m, about 59 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-19, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BA-moose-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-19: about 619 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.14 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
